title: Stream4D: 4D-Consistency for Streaming Autoregressive Diffusion Video Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19556v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming autoregressive diffusion models enable real-time, long-horizon video generation, but their training objectives optimize local frame prediction rather than the geometry and dynamics of a coherent world: long rollouts accumulate geometric drift and degrade into static or unnatural motion. Recent bidirectional approaches address this problem using rewards signals built upon 3D Gaussian-Splatting reconstruction. However, a single rigid 3d reconstruction cannot model a dynamic scene, so this critic penalizes genuine object motion as reconstruction error and is maximized by freezing the video. This shortcut is especially detrimental in the AR setting, where each chunk can propagate an already-static configuration. In this work, we propose Stream4D, which replaces the static critic with a feed-forward 4D reconstruction reward that explicitly models scene dynamics, allowing coherent motion to receive high consistency rewards. translated_title: Stream4D：用于流式自回归扩散视频模型的4D一致性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19556v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：流式自回归扩散模型能够实现实时、长时程的视频生成，但其训练目标优化的是局部帧预测，而非连贯世界的几何和动态特性：长时间滚动会导致几何漂移，并退化为静态或不自然的运动。近期的双向方法利用基于3D高斯泼溅重建的奖励信号来解决这一问题。然而，单一的刚性3D重建无法建模动态场景，因此这种批评者会将真实的物体运动视为重建误差，并通过冻结视频来最大化奖励。这一捷径在自回归设置中尤其有害，因为每个块都可能传播已经静态的配置。在本工作中，我们提出Stream4D，用前馈的4D重建奖励替代静态批评者，显式建模场景动态，使连贯运动能够获得高一致性奖励。为了进一步……
tldr: Stream4D通过引入前馈4D重建奖励来显式建模场景动态，解决了流式自回归扩散视频模型中的几何漂移和静态化问题，从而在长时程视频生成中保持连贯性和一致性。
en_tdlr: Stream4D introduces a feed-forward 4D reconstruction reward to explicitly model scene dynamics, addressing geometric drift and static degeneration in streaming autoregressive diffusion video models, thereby maintaining coherence and consistency in long-horizon video generation.
